_note: The U05 <image> PURE CORE, judged identically on all three renderers: the contentFit x contentPosition geometry solver, the cache-policy ladder (the legacy binary `cache` folded in), the transition gate (a memory hit never fades), the decode-at-display-size ladder, placeholder classification, the recycling identity, and the blurhash/thumbhash decoders pinned to exact RGBA bytes. Expected values were computed by an independent scratch implementation, and the two hash decoders were cross-checked against the reference algorithms before being pinned.

geometry.name: zero source is an empty rect

downscale.name: a small source is never upscaled
unknown display size decodes at source
